title: In-Place Indic Tokenizer Expansion and Continual Pretraining of Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B
abstract: arXiv:2610.15373v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We adapted Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B for eight Indian languages without changing its backbone architecture. We expanded the vocabulary in place from 131,072 to 163,072 entries using continued byte-pair encoding and AdaptMix rebalancing, reducing tokens per word by 38.6%. We initialized new input and output rows by averaging their original constituent rows, then trained them on 90% Indic and 10% English text before updating the backbone. Continual pretraining then progressed through broad training, high-quality annealing, and long-context training over approximately 1.27 trillion tokens. The annealed checkpoint gained 12.9 points on the Indic MILU benchmark but lost 3.4 on English MMLU. We also report practical negative results. Direct token addition underperformed continued byte-pair encoding. AdamW weight decay changed rows intended to stay fixed. Perplexity on an Indic-heavy holdout did not select the learning rate that best preserved

translated_title: Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 的原位印度语系分词器扩展与持续预训练
translated_abstract: 我们在不改变骨干架构的情况下，将 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 适配到八种印度语言。我们通过持续字节对编码和 AdaptMix 重平衡，将词表原位地从 131,072 条扩展到 163,072 条，使每词 token 数减少了 38.6%。我们通过对原始构成行取平均来初始化新的输入和输出嵌入行，然后在更新骨干之前，用 90% 的印度语系文本和 10% 的英语文本对其进行训练。随后，持续预训练经历了广泛训练、高质量退火和长上下文训练，总计约 1.27 万亿 token。退火后的检查点在 Indic MILU 基准上提升了 12.9 分，但在英语 MMLU 上损失了 3.4 分。我们还报告了实践中的负面结果：直接添加 token 的表现不如持续字节对编码；AdamW 权重衰减会改变本应保持固定的嵌入行；在以印度语系为主的保留集上的困惑度无法选出最能保持英语能力的学习率。
tldr: 通过原位扩展分词器词表（131K→163K）并在约 1.27 万亿 token 上进行持续预训练，成功将 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 适配到八种印度语言，在显著提升印度语系性能的同时尽量保持英语能力。
en_tdlr: In-place tokenizer vocabulary expansion (131K→163K) followed by continual pretraining on ~1.27 trillion tokens successfully adapted Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B to eight Indian languages with minimal English degradation.
